title: Decree on Clean Agriculture, No 122/GoV, dated 20 May 2026
text:
Government issued Decree on Clean Agriculture, No 122/GoV, dated 20 May 2026. This decree sets out principles, regulations and measures for the management and monitoring of clean agriculture to make such work efficient and effective, aiming to ensure that plants and plant products are of high quality, clean, safe for human and animal health and life, environmentally friendly, and can be linked to the region and the international community, contributing to the socio-economic development of the nation in a clean, green and sustainable direction.
